lineups.title: The projection leader
lineups.explanation: Maximizes ESPN-derived DraftKings expected points across the eligible research pool.

lineups.title: Less touchdown dependent
lineups.explanation: Discounts projected touchdown points by 50% and excludes players with reported injury designations. This is a floor proxy, not a percentile forecast.

lineups.title: Receiving opportunity
lineups.explanation: Adds 0.35 objective points per projected reception, discounts touchdown points by 25%, and excludes reported injury designations. Displayed totals remain the original mean projection.

lineups.title: SF game stack
lineups.explanation: Brock Purdy + Mike Evans, with De'Von Achane on the other side. Maximizes mean points around this fixed game stack; correlation can increase upside and shared downside.

lineups.title: BAL game stack
lineups.explanation: Lamar Jackson + Zay Flowers, with Chris Olave on the other side. Maximizes mean points around this fixed game stack; correlation can increase upside and shared downside.

lineups.title: DAL game stack
lineups.explanation: Dak Prescott + CeeDee Lamb, with Terry McLaurin on the other side. Maximizes mean points around this fixed game stack; correlation can increase upside and shared downside.
